faqs.question: Are hornets common in Hoboken, NJ?
faqs.answer: Yes, hornets are common in Hoboken, particularly during late summer and early fall. Waterfront areas and neighborhoods near Stevens Park and Elysian Park frequently see hornet activity due to the proximity to green spaces and protective structures.
